title: Introduction to Storage
overview: Storage allows applications to save data locally on a user's device so it can be accessed later.

example.title: Storage Concept
example.content:
Application Data
 ↓
Local Storage
 ↓
Retrieve Later

title: AsyncStorage
overview: AsyncStorage is a simple key-value storage system used for saving small amounts of persistent data.

title: Secure Storage
overview: Secure storage is used to store sensitive information like authentication tokens securely on the device.

example.title: Secure Data
example.content:
Store:
✔ Tokens
✔ Password Keys
✔ Sensitive Information

title: Expo SecureStore
overview: Expo SecureStore provides encrypted storage for sensitive key-value data.

title: File Storage
overview: File storage allows applications to save and manage files such as images, documents, and downloaded content.

example.title: File Storage
example.content:

 ↓

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned about local storage, AsyncStorage, SecureStore, and file storage options in Expo applications.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ AsyncStorage stores simple data.
